descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Pharma Technical Fall Student Analyst position, based in Mississauga, offers undergraduate students a valuable opportunity to delve into the heart of Roche's Technical Operations, crucial for manufacturing their medicines. By collaborating closely with stakeholders across various Pharma functions, students gain practical exposure to process implementation, project management, and innovative technological applications that enhance business productivity and profitability. This role involves diverse project assignments and rotations across key areas such as Global Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Biologics Manufacturing, Strategy & Engineering, Technical Development, and Operations Procurement. Roche emphasizes cross-functional collaboration and strict adherence to laws, regulations, and company policies, ensuring a comprehensive learning environment for budding professionals. The Opportunity:
• Participate in Pharma Technical projects, process improvements, and support activities.
• Contribute to system and process design under supervision, ensuring goals and timelines are met.
• Work with peers and cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcomes.
• Build experience in Pharma Technical Operations project management, organizational skills, and interaction with specialists.
• Practice self-management, time management, and goal-setting; work with Pharma Technical mentors to develop career goals. Who You Are:
• Must be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree In Industrial Engineering, Operations, Business/Commerce or related fields.
• Excellent organizational, oral and written communication skills
• Strong attention to detail including the ability to accomplish a task while demonstrating a thorough concern for all the areas involved
• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well with others in a proactive, positive and constructive manner
• Proven critical thinking and creativity skills; solve problems by applying technical and functional experiences
• Highly motivated, self-driven individual with passion working within pharmaceutical industry Additional Information:
• Duration: (4 months), work term (Full time) and will begin in (Sept 2026)
• Location: Based in Mississauga, Ontario.
• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of days in the office). This position is not eligible for relocation support. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambition
